item.title: WILLIAMS: Weeks 2-3 Under the Gold Dome
item.description: We are now well into the 2026 Legislative Session, and the work under the Gold Dome is moving quickly. Even with winter weather trying to slow things down, the Senate stayed on track and focused on delivering results for Georgians.

item.title: Hancock Co. brothers sentenced for lottery crimes
item.description: Two Hancock County brothers will serve long prison sentences stemming from convictions in Columbia County Superior Court related to state lottery ticket fraud and other criminal charges.

item.title: KEMP: An open letter to my fellow Georgians
item.description: In recent weeks, our state has faced a seemingly endless onslaught of weather events.

item.title: Boyer elected chairman of State Intelligence Network
item.description: The Georgia State Intelligence Network has elected Milledgeville Police Department Maj. Linc Boyer as its new chairman.

item.title: Tax Assessors board aims to focus on filling vacancies
item.description: A laundry list of recommendations related to a recent state performance review of the Baldwin County Board of Tax Assessors and its chief appraiser is not being ignored, it’s just not considered top priority right now.

item.title: Atrium Health Navicent program offers high school seniors assistance in pursuing health care careers
item.description: Atrium Health Navicent is now accepting applications for the Rise to Success program, which offers graduating high school seniors employment and tuition assistance as they pursue health care careers. Applications are due March 1.

item.title: Man crashes truck into Eatonton convenience store
item.description: A man crashed his pickup truck through the front doors of Jet Food Store No. 44 in Eatonton on Wednesday morning.

item.title: Search for missing autistic boy ends in tragedy
item.description: A 7-year-old non-verbal autistic boy who wandered away from home at Lake Oconee in Putnam County was later discovered in the lake by a mail carrier.

item.title: MILLIANS: More chicken wings, please
item.description: There’s not a better time (except maybe Thanksgiving) to talk about menus than this week, leading up to Sunday’s Super Bowl XL game between the Seattle Seahawks and the New England Patriots.

item.title: GMC Prep Bulldogs have a training home of their own
item.description: They could see it developing all throughout the summer and the 2025 football season. Once things wrapped up for the Georgia Military College Prep School Bulldogs last fall, a new era began in development of football and other student-athletes as it was time to move into their own little home.
